values.note: Basic sites $35 a night, the three electric sites $45; the fee includes a daily park pass for one vehicle and paddle-craft use. Each extra vehicle pays the $7 daily entrance fee.

fees.source: https://www.westminsterco.gov/Camping ('Basic campsite: $35 per night'; 'Campsite with electric hookup (sites 52, 53, and ADA site 16): $45 per night'; 'The reservation fee includes a daily parks pass for one vehicle'; 'Additional vehicles must pay for $7 daily entrance fee'), read 2026-10-27

hookups.source: https://www.westminsterco.gov/Camping ('three campsites that have electric hookups; site 52 with 20 to 30 amps and 120 volts, Site 53 with 30 amps and 120 volts, and the ADA Site 16 with 20 amps'; 'The rest of the sites have no hookups'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 66 campsites (plus six bell tents); only sites 52 (20-30 A), 53 (30 A) and ADA site 16 (20 A, not recommended for trailers) have electric. One camping unit and one tent, or two tents, per site; one vehicle included.

sites.source: https://www.westminsterco.gov/Camping ('There are 66 campsites available for reservation and six Deluxe Bell Tents. The main campground accommodates RV units, camp trailers and tents.'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Two permanent restroom buildings with free open-air showers and drinking water; self-serve water-fill spigots. No dump station in the park; the city's station is at the Big Dry Creek Wastewater Treatment Facility, 13150 Huron Street, for a fee.

facilities.source: https://www.westminsterco.gov/Camping ('two permanent restroom facilities with free outdoor/open-air showers and drinking water. There are also self-serve water-fill spigots'; 'There is no dump station available at Standley Lake'), read 2026-10-27

season.source: https://www.westminsterco.gov/Camping ('Public camping is available May 1 through September 30'; 'No camping is allowed October 1 through April 30.'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Reservation only, through the City of Westminster's WebTrac site; booking opens in January each year. Same-day sites are first-come, booked in person before 8 pm. 14 consecutive days, then 24 hours out of the park. Full refund with 72 hours' notice. Gates close at 10 pm; call the gatehouse (303-425-1097) if arriving later.

booking.source: https://www.westminsterco.gov/Camping ('by reservation only. Reservations can be made beginning in January of each year'; 'Same-day reservations are on a first-come, first-served basis. Any in-person reservation needs to be done before 8 pm.'; 'Campsite(s) may only be used for up to 14 days'; 'Reserve a Campsite' link), read 2026-10-27

note: City of Westminster regional park on Standley Lake reservoir; no-alcohol park, no glass. The southern 'waterfront loop' (e.g. site 28) overlooks Standley Lake from a low bench set back behind an open grassy/drawdown apron - open lake view, no pads on the shore; interior loops have no water view. --Claude
